standard_prerequisites: Original cited global Kuranishi-chart existence/equivalence, ordinary Thom/Gysin/localisation/compactness and gluing facts; current author appendices retained. No recursive re-proof of external prerequisites.
core_obligations: H2: Compare global-Kuranishi Gromov-Witten classes with Ruan-Tian pseudocycle classes for semipositive targets. Given the earlier chart construction, general compactness/gluing and cobordism facts, the author still constructs a parameterised perturbed chart over a good finite cover with perturbations supported away from nodes, identifies both endpoint virtual classes with the correct covering degree, and identifies the terminal transverse virtual class with the pseudocycle homology class by the compact-support/Borel-Moore comparison diagram. Stable range is handled geometrically and unstable range by the original Divisor/Symmetry definitions. This is not a mere renaming of the two invariant definitions.
proof_roadmap: Complete author result family and its explicit proof chain/technical appendices in the shared fixed work.

Three new families have distinct targets; shared appendices stay one author asset.
